<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.2pt;text-align:center;"><u><b>CAUTIONARY NOTE REGARDING FORWARD-LOOKING STATEMENTS</b></u></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;"><i>This Annual Report on Form&nbsp;10-K contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of the safe harbor provisions of Section&nbsp;21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, relating to future events or the future financial performance of the Company.&nbsp;&nbsp;In some cases, you can identify forward-looking statements by the following words: &#8220;anticipate,&#8221; &#8220;believe,&#8221; &#8220;continue,&#8221; &#8220;could,&#8221; &#8220;estimate,&#8221; &#8220;expect,&#8221; &#8220;intend,&#8221; &#8220;may,&#8221; &#8220;plan,&#8221; &#8220;potential,&#8221; &#8220;project,&#8221; &#8220;should,&#8221; &#8220;will,&#8221; &#8220;would,&#8221; or the negative of these terms or other comparable terminology, although not all forward-looking statements contain these words. Forward-looking statements are only predictions or statements of intention subject to risks and uncertainties and actual events or results could differ materially from those projected.&nbsp;&nbsp;Forward-looking statements are based on information available at the time the statements are made and involve known and unknown risks, uncertainties and other factors that may cause our results, levels of activity, performance or achievements to be materially different from the information expressed or implied by the forward-looking statements in this Annual Report on Form&nbsp;10-K. Factors that could cause actual results to differ include the risks, uncertainties and other matters set forth below under the caption &#8220;Risk Factors&#8221; and the matters set forth under the captions &#8220;Business&#8221; and &#8220;Management&#8217;s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations,&#8221; as well as those discussed elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form&nbsp;10-K.</i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:center;"><u><b>DOCUMENTS INCORPORATED BY REFERENCE</b></u></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:center;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">Portions of the Company&#8217;s definitive proxy statement for its 2021&nbsp;Annual Meeting of Shareholders are incorporated by reference in Part&nbsp;III.</p>

<div contenteditable="false" data-applyto="p" data-auto-pgnum="start" data-displaynum="2" data-fontname="Times New Roman" data-fontsize="10pt" data-numstyle="a" data-prefix="" data-startnum="2" data-suffix="" data-textalign="center">&nbsp;</div>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<div class="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-left: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt">
<div class="PGNUM" style="text-align: center; width: 100%; font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt;">2</div>

<hr style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; border: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000">
<div class="PGHDR" style="text-align: left; width: 100%">&nbsp;</div>
</div>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:center;"><u><b>PART&nbsp;I</b></u></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:center;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><u><b>Item 1.&nbsp;&nbsp;Business</b></u></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b>General</b>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 49pt;">IKONICS Corporation (&#8220;IKONICS&#8221; or the &#8220;Company&#8221;) was incorporated in Minnesota as Chroma-Glo,&nbsp;Inc. in 1952 and changed its name to The Chromaline Corporation in 1982.&nbsp; In December&nbsp;2002, the Company changed its name to IKONICS Corporation.&nbsp; The Company&#8217;s two traditional businesses, Chromaline and IKONICS Imaging, have been the development, manufacture and selling of photosensitive liquids (&#8220;emulsions&#8221;) and films for the screen printing, awards and recognition industries and consumer products markets.&nbsp;&nbsp;These sales have been augmented with inkjet receptive films, ancillary chemicals and related equipment to provide a full line of products and services to its customers. These products are sold worldwide primarily through distributors.&nbsp; The Company further diversified itself by expanding its business to industrial markets. These efforts now include the Company&#8217;s Advanced Material Solutions (&#8220;AMS&#8221;) business unit which uses the Company&#8217;s proprietary processes and photoresist film for the abrasive etching of composite materials, industrial ceramics, silicon wafers,&nbsp;and glass wafers.&nbsp;&nbsp;The customer base for AMS is primarily the aerospace and electronics industries.&nbsp;&nbsp;Based on its expertise in ultraviolet curable fluids and inkjet receptive substrates, the Company has also developed a patented digital texturing technology (&#8220;DTX&#8221;) for putting patterns and textures into steel molds for the plastic injection molding industry. The original equipment manufacturer (&#8220;OEM&#8221;) for the Company&#8217;s DTX technology is primarily the automotive industry. The Company offers a suite of products to the mold making industry.&nbsp;&nbsp;Industrial inkjet printers, which are integral to the DTX system, are manufactured by a third party and sold by IKONICS.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company&#8217;s business plan is to sell consumable fluids and transfer films.&nbsp;&nbsp;For most markets, these sales are direct to the mold maker.&nbsp;&nbsp;The DTX technology is also utilized in prototyping where the Company&#8217;s technology offers a unique combination of high definition, large format prints, and abrasion resistance.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b>Products</b>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 49pt;">The Company has four primary technology platforms: ultraviolet (UV) chemistry, film coating and construction, technical abrasive etching, and industrial inkjet printing. The Company&#8217;s traditional products and new initiatives are based on these platforms and their combinations. The Company&#8217;s Chromaline and ImageMate branded products for the screen printing industry and IKONICS Imaging products for the both the awards and recognition and consumer product markets are based on UV chemistry and film coating and construction capabilities; the AMS offering is a combination of UV chemistry, film coating and construction and technical abrasive etching capabilities; DTX is a combination of UV chemistry, film coating and construction, and industrial inkjet printing.&nbsp;&nbsp;There is overlap and synergy in the market between the Chromaline,&nbsp;IKONICS&nbsp;Imaging, AMS and DTX product offerings, and the Company offers ancillary products, including equipment to provide customers with a total solution.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company considers this combination of core technologies and product offerings to be unique.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 49pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b>Distribution and Customers</b>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 49pt;">The Company currently has approximately 200 domestic and international distributors for its Chromaline and ImageMate screen printing emulsions and films.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company&#8217;s abrasive etching products are mainly sold directly to end users in the awards and recognition market under the IKONICS&nbsp;Imaging brand. AMS products are sold either directly to users or the Company offers AMS as a service. DTX includes the sales of consumable inks and films to customers that have purchased specialized industrial inkjet printers from the Company&#8217;s strategic partner. DTX sales are primarily direct to end users. The Company markets and sells its products through magazine advertising, trade shows and the internet.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:49pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:49pt;">The Company has a diverse customer base both domestically and abroad, with international sales accounting for 29.7% of total sales in 2020&nbsp;and 29.4% of sales in 2019, and does not depend on one or a few customers for a material portion of its revenues.&nbsp; In 2020&nbsp;and 2019, no one customer accounted for more than 10% of net sales.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:49pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b>Quality Control in Manufacturing</b>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:48pt;">In March&nbsp;1994,&nbsp;IKONICS became the first company in northern Minnesota to receive ISO&nbsp;9001 certification.&nbsp; ISO 9000 is a worldwide standard issued by the International Organization for Standardization that provides a framework for quality assurance.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company has been recertified every three years beginning in 1997.&nbsp; IKONICS&#8217; quality function goal is to train all employees properly in both their work and in the importance of their work.&nbsp; Internal records of quality, including related graphs and tables, are reviewed regularly and discussions are held among management and employees regarding how improvements might be realized.&nbsp; The Company has rigorous materials selection procedures and also uses testing procedures to assure its products meet quality standards.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:48pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b>Research and Development and Intellectual Property</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:49pt;">The Company incurred costs totaling 5.0% of sales, or $671,000, on research and development in 2020, and 4.9% of sales, or $870,000, in 2019.&nbsp; In its research program,&nbsp;IKONICS has developed ultraviolet light-sensitive chemistries used in the manufacturing of screen print stencils, photoresists for abrasive etching and acid resists, stencils for consumer products, and prototyping ink jet fluids,&nbsp;and ink jet receptive films.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company has a number of patents and patent applications on these chemistries and applications.&nbsp;&nbsp;There can be no assurance that any patent granted to the Company will provide adequate protection to the Company&#8217;s intellectual property.&nbsp; Within the Company, steps are taken to protect the Company&#8217;s trade secrets, including physical security, confidentiality and non-competition agreements with employees, non-disclosure agreements where applicable, and confidentiality agreements with vendors.&nbsp;&nbsp;Over the past few years, the Company has directed a larger portion of it research and development resources towards industrial inkjettable fluids and ink jet receptive substrates along with films for the consumer products market.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company has also invested significant resources for personnel and equipment to develop proprietary products and techniques for the etching of composite materials, industrial ceramics and electronic wafers.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:49pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 49pt;">In addition to its patents, the Company has various trademarks including the &#8220;IKONICS&#174;,&#8221; &#8220;Chromaline&#174;,&#8221; &#8220;IKONICS Imaging&#174;,&#8221; &#8220;Precision Abrasive Machining&#174;,&#8221; &#8220;PhotoBrasive&#174;,&#8221; &#8220;AccuArt&#174;,&#8221;&nbsp; &#8220;image mate&#174;,&#8221; &#8220;Alpha FlexTrace&#174;,&#8221; &#8220;Alpha MicroCap&#174;," &#8220;DTX&#174;,&#8221; &#8220;SubTHAT!&#174;,&#8221; and &#8220;IKONART&#174;&#8221; trademarks.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:48.95pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<div class="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-left: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt">
<div class="PGNUM" style="text-align: center; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Times New Roman;">3</div>

<hr style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; border: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000">
<div class="PGHDR" style="text-align: left; width: 100%">&nbsp;</div>
</div>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b>Raw Materials</b>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 49pt;">The primary raw materials used by IKONICS in its production are photopolymers, polyester films, polyvinylacetates, polyvinylalcohols and water.&nbsp; The Company&#8217;s purchasing staff leads in the identification of both domestic and foreign sources for raw materials and negotiates price and terms for all domestic and foreign markets.&nbsp; IKONICS&#8217; involvement in foreign markets has given it the opportunity to become a global buyer of raw materials at lower overall cost.&nbsp; The Company has a number of suppliers for its operations.&nbsp; Some suppliers provide a significant amount of key raw materials to the Company, but the Company believes alternative sources are available for most materials.&nbsp; For those raw materials where an alternative source is not readily available, the Company has contingency raw material replacement plans.&nbsp; To date, there have been no significant shortages of raw materials.&nbsp; The Company believes it has good supplier relations.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:48.95pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b>Competition</b>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:49pt;">The Company competes in its markets based on product development capability, quality, reliability, availability, technical support and price.&nbsp; Though the screen printing market is much larger than the awards and recognition market,&nbsp;IKONICS commands significantly more market share in the latter.&nbsp;&nbsp;IKONICS has two primary domestic competitors in its screen printing film business.&nbsp; They are larger than IKONICS and possess greater resources than the Company in many areas.&nbsp; The Company has numerous competitors in the market for screen print emulsions, many of whom are larger than IKONICS and possess greater resources.&nbsp; The market for the Company&#8217;s abrasive etching products in the awards and recognition market has one significant competitor.&nbsp; IKONICS considers itself to be the leader in this market.&nbsp; There are significant competitors, using different technologies in the new markets being entered by the Company. The primary competition for AMS is from other machining methods, most of which are well established. The primary competition for DTX comes from old, well-established technologies based on wax and screen printing and new competition from laser technologies.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:49pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b>Government Regulation</b>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:49pt;">The Company is subject to a variety of federal, state and local industrial laws and regulations, including those relating to the discharge of material into the environment and protection of the environment.&nbsp; The governmental authorities primarily responsible for regulating the Company&#8217;s environmental compliance are the Environmental Protection Agency, the Minnesota Pollution Control Agency and the Western Lake Superior Sanitary District.&nbsp; Failure to comply with the laws promulgated by these authorities may result in monetary sanctions, liability for environmental clean-up and other equitable remedies.&nbsp; To maintain compliance, the Company may make occasional changes in its waste generation and disposal procedures.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:49pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:49pt;">These laws and regulations have not had a material effect upon the capital expenditures or competitive position of the Company.&nbsp; The Company believes that it complies in all material respects with the various federal, state and local regulations that apply to its current operations.&nbsp; Failure to comply with these regulations could have a negative impact on the Company&#8217;s operations and capital expenditures and such negative impact could be significant.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:49pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 49pt;">The Company also is subject to regulations from foreign governments covering the importation of certain chemicals. The Company believes that it complies in all material respects with these regulations that apply to its current products.&nbsp; Failure to comply with these regulations could have a negative impact on the Company&#8217;s operations and capital expenditures and such negative impact could be significant.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b>Employees</b>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:49pt;">As of February&nbsp;28, 2021, the Company ha<font style="color:null;">d 58&nbsp;total and&nbsp;full-time employees, 54&nbsp;of whom</font> are located at the Company&#8217;s two facilities in Duluth, Minnesota and four&nbsp;of whom are outside technical sales representatives in various locations in the United States.&nbsp;&nbsp;None of the Company&#8217;s employees are subject to a collective bargaining agreement and the Company believes that its employee relations are good.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:49pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><u><b>Item 1A.&nbsp; Risk Factors</b></u></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -18pt;"><b>Covid-19 Related Risks</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 14.7pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt;"><i><b>A public health crisis or global outbreak of disease, including the pandemic caused by coronavirus disease 2019 (&#8220;COVID-19&#8221;) has had, and we believe will continue to have, a negative effect on the Company's operations, supply chain and workforce, creating business disruptions that could have a material adverse impact on the Company&#8217;s financial condition, results of operations and cash flows</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 54pt;">The pandemic caused by COVID-19 was first reported in Wuhan, China, in December 2019 and has since spread to all geographic regions where the Company&#8217;s products are produced and sold. The global, regional and local spread of COVID-19 has resulted in significant global mitigation measures, including government-directed quarantines, social distancing and shelter-in-place mandates, travel restrictions and/or bans, and restricted access to certain corporate facilities and manufacturing sites.&nbsp;&nbsp;Uncertainty with respect to the severity and duration of the pandemic has contributed to periods of volatility and disruption&nbsp;of financial markets. While the severity and duration of the COVID-19 pandemic remain uncertain, impacts to the Company may include, but are not limited to: fluctuations in the Company&#8217;s stock price due to market volatility; a decrease in demand for the Company&#8217;s products; reduced profitability; supply chain disruptions impeding the Company&#8217;s ability to ship and/or receive product; potential interruptions or limitations to manufacturing operations imposed by local, state or federal governments; shortages of key raw materials; workforce absenteeism and distraction; labor shortages; customer credit concerns; cyber security and data accessibility disruptions due to remote working arrangements; reduced sources of liquidity; increased borrowing costs; and potential asset impairment charges. Business disruptions and market volatility resulting from the COVID-19 pandemic could continue to have a material adverse impact on the Company&#8217;s results of operations, financial condition and cash flows.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 54pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -21pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;"><i><b>The Company received funding and subsequently had its entire loan forgiven&nbsp;under the Coronavirus Aid, Relief and Economic Security (CARES) Act.&nbsp; There is no guarantee that the Company will not become subject to future penalties or that the decision to forgive the loan in whole or part will be rescinded.</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 63pt;">On April 18, 2020, the Company executed a promissory note in favor of BMO Harris Bank evidencing an unsecured loan in the aggregate principal amount of $1,214,500, which was made pursuant to the Paycheck Protection Program, or the PPP. The PPP was established under the CARES Act, which was enacted on March 27, 2020, and is administered by the U.S. Small Business Administration, or the SBA. All the funds under the loan were disbursed to the Company on April 22, 2020. The Company used all proceeds from the loan to retain employees, maintain payroll and make rental and utility payments.&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 63pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 63pt;">Under the terms of the CARES Act, loan recipients can apply for and be granted forgiveness for all or a portion of the loans granted under the PPP.&nbsp; In 2020,&nbsp;the Company submitted an application for 100% forgiveness of&nbsp;the PPP Loan and upon approval by the SBA and the lender,&nbsp;the Company received forgiveness for 100% of the&nbsp;$1,214,500 loan.&nbsp; The Company is not aware of or anticipating any further review of its loan forgiveness, but the loan itself and the forgiveness of the loan could be subject for further examination by the SBA or the lender.&nbsp; If the decision to forgive the loan is reversed in part of whole, the Company will be required to repay the outstanding principal, along with accrued interest.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 63pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 29.7pt 0pt 11.7pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -18pt;"><b>Strategic and Competitive Related Risks</b></p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0pt;"><i><b>The Company&#8217;s DTX and AMS initiatives involve new technologies that might not be executed successfully and might not achieve market acceptance.</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 49pt;">The Company&#8217;s DTX and AMS initiatives involve technologies that might never achieve market acceptance.&nbsp;&nbsp;During 2020&nbsp;and 2019, the Company generated operating losses in its AMS segment while the&nbsp;DTX segment has realized operating income since 2015.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company&#8217;s ability for generating profits from these initiatives will depend on its products gaining market acceptance among customers, which cannot be guaranteed.&nbsp;&nbsp;The degree of market acceptance of any new products the Company develops will depend on a number of factors, including:</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:18pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">the Company&#8217;s ability to successfully develop its technologies and products to include the capabilities the Company intends;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:18pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">

		<tr style="vertical-align: top; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#8226;&nbsp;</p>
			</td>
			<td style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">the Company&#8217;s ability to accurately assess the functions and features customers desire;</p>
			</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:18pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">

			<td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#8226;&nbsp;</p>
			</td>
			<td style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">the perceived effectiveness and price of the Company&#8217;s products compared to alternative products and technologies;</p>
			</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:18pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">

		<tr style="vertical-align: top; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#8226;&nbsp;</p>
			</td>
			<td style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">the development of new products and technologies by current competitors or new competitors that might enter the Company&#8217;s markets; and</p>
			</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:18pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">

		<tr style="vertical-align: top; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#8226;&nbsp;</p>
			</td>
			<td style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">the strength of the Company&#8217;s marketing and distribution functions.</p>
			</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:18pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">If new products that the Company develops do not have the capabilities the Company expects or fail to achieve an adequate level of acceptance by customers for any reason, then the Company&#8217;s AMS and DTX business units could fail to generate the revenues the Company expects and may not become profitable or sustain profitability.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<div class="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-left: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt">
<div class="PGNUM" style="text-align: center; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Times New Roman;">4</div>

<hr style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; border: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000">
<div class="PGHDR" style="text-align: left; width: 100%">&nbsp;</div>
</div>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><i><b>If the Company&#8217;s new products and technologies do not achieve market acceptance, the Company will not realize a return on its investments in its new business initiatives.</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 49pt;">The Company has invested, and plans to continue to invest, significant resources in its research and development efforts to develop technology for its business units.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company spent 5.0% of sales, or $671,000, on research and development in 2019&nbsp;and 4.9% of sales, or $870,000, in 2019.&nbsp;&nbsp;A substantial portion of these investments was for new products and initiatives.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company plans to continue to invest significant resources in research and development of new products and&nbsp;initiatives for the foreseeable future.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company believes successful execution of these initiatives and new products is important for its ability to grow its revenues and profits.&nbsp;&nbsp;However, if the Company fails to generate its projected revenues from these products and initiatives, the Company&#8217;s investments in these areas would not generate the profits the Company expects and its results of operations, financial condition and prospects would be materially and adversely affected.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><i><b>The Company faces significant competition and expects to face increasing competition in many aspects of its businesses, which could cause operating results to suffer.</b></i>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">The Company operates in highly competitive industries that experience rapid technological and market developments, changes in customer needs, and frequent product introductions and improvements, particularly with respect to the AMS and DTX businesses.&nbsp;&nbsp;If the Company is unable to anticipate and respond to these developments, its products or technologies could become uncompetitive or obsolete.&nbsp;&nbsp;Most of the Company&#8217;s competitors in the AMS and DTX fields are larger and better capitalized than the Company with longer operating histories.&nbsp;&nbsp;These advantages could allow the Company&#8217;s competitors to invest more resources in research and development and sales and marketing than the Company, which could make the competitive products more attractive or better known to consumers than the Company&#8217;s products.&nbsp;&nbsp;In addition, because there is potential for rapid technological change in fields in which the Company operates, the Company could face competition from new sources in the future that customers find more attractive.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">The Company also could face increased competition in its traditional Chromaline and IKONICS Imaging units.&nbsp;&nbsp;Capital costs for machinery necessary to operate in these industries have decreased in recent years, increasing the possibility that the Company will face new competitors.&nbsp;&nbsp;An increase in the amount of competition the Company faces, or a loss of competitiveness in any of the Company&#8217;s business units for any reason, could adversely affect its revenues and gross margins.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt 7.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -9pt;"><b>Regulatory and Legal Risks</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><i><b>The Company&#8217;s failure to comply with environmental laws and regulations could harm its business and results of operations.</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">The manufacturing of the Company&#8217;s products requires the use of hazardous materials that are subject to a broad array of environmental laws and regulations.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company&#8217;s failure to comply with these laws or regulations could result in:</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

			</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:36pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:-18pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">The Company&#8217;s failure to manage the use, transportation, emissions, discharge, storage, recycling or disposal of hazardous materials could lead to increased costs or future liabilities.&nbsp;&nbsp;Environmental laws and regulations also could require the Company to acquire pollution abatement or remediation equipment, modify product designs or incur other expenses.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><i><b>Third parties may claim the Company infringes their intellectual property rights, which could harm the Company&#8217;s business.</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">The Company may face claims that it infringes other parties&#8217; intellectual rights.&nbsp;&nbsp;Regardless of a claim&#8217;s merit, claims that the Company&#8217;s products or processes infringe the intellectual property rights of others could cause the Company to incur large costs to respond to, defend, and resolve the claims, and they may divert the efforts and attention of management and technical personnel.&nbsp;&nbsp;As a result of any intellectual property rights infringement claims, the Company could be required to:</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">

		<tr style="vertical-align: top; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">

			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">stop manufacturing, using, or selling products or technology subject to infringement claims;</p>
			</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">

			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">develop other products or technology not subject to infringement claims, which could be time-consuming, costly or impossible; or</p>
			</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">

		<tr style="vertical-align: top; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#8226;</td>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">These actions could harm the Company&#8217;s competitive position, result in additional expenses, or require the Company to impair its assets.&nbsp;&nbsp;If the Company alters or stops production of affected items, its ability to generate revenue could be harmed.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<div class="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-left: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt">
<div class="PGNUM" style="text-align: center; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Times New Roman;">5</div>

<hr style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; border: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000">
<div class="PGHDR" style="text-align: left; width: 100%">&nbsp;</div>
</div>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><i><b>The Company may be unable to enforce or protect its intellectual property rights, which may harm its ability to compete and may harm its business.</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">The Company&#8217;s ability to enforce its patents, trademarks and other intellectual property rights is subject to general litigation risks, as well as uncertainty as to the enforceability of the Company&#8217;s intellectual property rights in various countries.&nbsp;&nbsp;If the Company seeks to enforce its rights, it could become subject to claims that its intellectual property rights are invalid, not enforceable, or licensed to the opposing party.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company&#8217;s assertion of intellectual property rights also could result in the other party seeking to assert claims against the Company, which could harm the Company&#8217;s business.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company&#8217;s inability to enforce its intellectual property rights for any reason could harm its competitive position and business.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><i><b>If the Company is unable to protect the confidentiality of its proprietary information and know-how, the value of its technology could be adversely affected.</b></i>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">In addition to patented technology, the Company relies on unpatented proprietary technology, trade secrets, processes and know-how.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company generally seeks to protect this information by confidentiality agreements with employees, consultants, advisors and third parties.&nbsp;&nbsp;These agreements may be breached, and the Company may not have adequate remedies for any such breach.&nbsp;&nbsp;In addition, the Company&#8217;s trade secrets may otherwise become known or be independently developed by competitors.&nbsp;&nbsp;To the extent that the Company&#8217;s employees, consultants or contractors use intellectual property owned by others in their work for the Company, disputes may arise as to the rights in related or resulting know-how and inventions.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt 7.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -9pt;"><b>General Economic and Operational Risks</b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt 7.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -9pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt 7.2pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -9pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -18pt;"><i><b>Adverse changes to global economic conditions generally, and to the aerospace and automotive industries in particular, may harm the Company&#8217;s business.</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt;">The prospects for economic growth in the United States and other countries remain uncertain and major economies where the Company conducts business could continue or return to recessionary conditions.&nbsp;&nbsp;Economic concerns and issues such as reduced access to capital for businesses or tariffs&nbsp;may cause the Company&#8217;s customers to delay or reduce purchases of the Company&#8217;s products.&nbsp;&nbsp;Given the continued uncertainty concerning the global economy, the Company also faces risks that may arise from financial difficulties experienced by suppliers and customers, such as an inability to collect receivables or the continued operation of suppliers.&nbsp; Global or local events, such as terrorist attacks, political insurgencies, electrical grid disruptions and outages, and pandemics including further spread of the&nbsp;coronavirus could also disrupt our operations, the operations of our suppliers and customers, or result in economic instability.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt;">The Company&#8217;s AMS segment focuses primarily on customers in the aerospace industry, and its DTX segment focuses primarily on customers in the automotive industry.&nbsp;&nbsp;The aerospace and automotive industries have experienced volatility in prior years in a manner similar to or greater than the global economy generally.&nbsp;&nbsp;If either or both these industries experiences difficulties that reduce demand for their products generally, the Company&#8217;s results of operations, financial condition and prospects would suffer.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><i><b>The Company conducts a global business that exposes it to additional risks.</b></i>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">The Company conducts business throughout the world, including in the United States, Europe, India&nbsp;and China.&nbsp;&nbsp;These international operations create a variety of risks and uncertainties, including:</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">

		<tr style="vertical-align: top; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#8226;</td>
			<td style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">rapid changes in government, economic and political policies and conditions, political or civil unrest or instability, terrorism or epidemics including the coronavirus;</p>
			</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">

			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates;</p>
			</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:18pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">

		<tr style="vertical-align: top; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#8226;</td>
			<td style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">compliance with and changes in foreign laws and regulations, as well as U.S. laws affecting the activities of U.S. companies abroad, including the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act of 1977, as amended (the &#8220;FCPA&#8221;);</p>
			</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:18pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">longer accounts receivable payment cycles and difficulties in collecting accounts receivable; and</p>
			</td>
		</tr>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:18pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">

		<tr style="vertical-align: top; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td style="width: 18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&#8226;</td>
			<td style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">
			<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">protectionist laws, tariffs&nbsp;and business practices that favor local producers.</p>
			</td>
		</tr>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:18pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">The occurrence of any one of these risks could negatively affect the Company&#8217;s international business and, consequently, its results of operations generally.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><i><b>The Company faces risks related to sales through distributors and other third parties.</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">A significant portion of the Company&#8217;s sales, including nearly all sales of its Chromaline products,&nbsp;were conducted through third parties.&nbsp;&nbsp;Using third parties for distribution exposes the Company to many risks, including competitive pressure, concentration, credit risk and compliance risks.&nbsp;&nbsp;Distributors may sell products that compete with the Company&#8217;s products, and the loss of a distributor could reduce the Company&#8217;s revenue.&nbsp;&nbsp;Distributors may face financial difficulties, including bankruptcy, which could harm the Company&#8217;s collection of accounts receivable and financial results.&nbsp;&nbsp;Violations of the FCPA or similar laws by distributors or other third-party intermediaries could have a material impact on the Company&#8217;s business.&nbsp;&nbsp;Failing to manage risks related to the Company&#8217;s use of distributors may reduce sales, increase expenses, and weaken its competitive position.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><i><b>Increases in prices and declines in the availability of raw materials could negatively impact the Company&#8217;s financial results.</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">Certain raw materials needed to manufacture products are obtained from a limited number of suppliers and many of the raw materials are petroleum-based.&nbsp;&nbsp;Under normal market conditions, these raw materials are generally available on the open market from a variety of producers.&nbsp;&nbsp;While alternate supplies of most key raw materials are available, supplier production outages may lead to strained supply-demand situations for certain raw materials.&nbsp;&nbsp;The substitution of key raw materials could require the Company to identify new supply sources, or reformulate and retest products or processes.&nbsp;&nbsp;From time to time, the prices and availability of these raw materials may fluctuate, which could impair the Company&#8217;s ability to procure necessary materials, or increase the cost of manufacturing products.&nbsp;&nbsp;If the prices of raw materials increase in a short period of time, the Company may be unable to pass these increases on to its customers in a timely manner or at all, which could reduce its gross margins.&nbsp;&nbsp;Like most companies in the Company&#8217;s industries, the Company does not have long-term supply contracts for most of its key raw materials, which exacerbates the foregoing risks to the Company.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><i><b>If any of the Company&#8217;s current&nbsp;single or limited source suppliers become unavailable or inadequate, its customer relationships, results of operations and financial condition may be adversely affected.</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">The Company acquires certain of its materials that are critical to its operations from a limited number of third parties.&nbsp;&nbsp;Should any of the Company&#8217;s current single or limited source suppliers become unavailable or inadequate, or impose terms unacceptable to the Company such as increased pricing terms, the Company could be required to spend a significant amount of time and expense to develop alternate sources of supply, and may not be successful in doing so on acceptable terms or at all.&nbsp;&nbsp;If the Company is unable to find a suitable supplier for a particular material, it could be required to modify its existing business processes or offerings to accommodate the situation.&nbsp;&nbsp;As a result, the loss of a single or limited source supplier could adversely affect the Company&#8217;s relationship with its customers and its results of operations and financial condition.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<div class="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-left: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt">
<div class="PGNUM" style="text-align: center; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Times New Roman;">6</div>

<hr style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; border: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000">
<div class="PGHDR" style="text-align: left; width: 100%">&nbsp;</div>
</div>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><i><b>The Company depends on one manufacturer to make and sell DTX printers. If the manufacturer ceased to make or sell DTX printers, or failed to meet quality standards, the Company&#8217;s financial results and prospects would be adversely affected.</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">The Company relies on one company to manufacture and sell DTX printers.&nbsp;&nbsp;If the manufacturer ceased to produce or devote resources to selling DTX printers, due to a change in company strategy, to focus on alternative initiatives, or for any other reason, the Company would need to find an alternative manufacturer and seller of DTX printers.&nbsp;&nbsp;Finding an alternative manufacturer and seller of DTX printers could result in additional costs and delays in growing the Company&#8217;s DTX business unit, which would adversely affect the Company&#8217;s financial results and prospects.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">In addition, if these manufacturers failed to produce DTX printers that satisfy the Company&#8217;s quality standards, the Company&#8217;s reputation with end users could be harmed and the Company could be forced to find a new manufacturer.&nbsp;&nbsp;Either of these results also would harm the Company&#8217;s business and prospects.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><i><b>The inability to attract and retain qualified personnel could adversely impact the Company&#8217;s business.</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">Sustaining and growing the Company&#8217;s business depends on the recruitment, development and retention of qualified employees, including management and research and development personnel.&nbsp;&nbsp;The inability to recruit and retain key personnel or the unexpected loss of key personnel may adversely affect the Company&#8217;s operations.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left;"><i><b>We heavily rely on our information technology systems and are vulnerable to damage and interruption.</b></i>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: -18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; The Company relies&nbsp;on our information technology systems and infrastructure to process transactions and manage its&nbsp;business, including maintaining employee, client and supplier information.&nbsp; The Company has also engaged third parties, including cloud providers, to store, transfer and process data.&nbsp; The&nbsp;information technology systems, as well as the systems of our customers, suppliers and other partners, are vulnerable to outages and an increasing risk of deliberate intrusions to gain access to and exploit company sensitive information. Similarly, data security breaches by employees and others with or without permitted access to the Company's&nbsp;systems pose a risk that sensitive data may be exposed to unauthorized persons or to the public. The Company may be unable to prevent outages or security breaches in its&nbsp;systems that could adversely affect results of operations and cause reputational harm.</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><i><b>The Company&#8217;s operating results and financial condition may fluctuate on a quarterly and annual basis.</b></i></p>

<p style="margin-left: -18pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt;">The Company&#8217;s operating results and financial condition may fluctuate from quarter to quarter and year to year, and could vary due to a number of factors, some of which are outside of the Company&#8217;s control.&nbsp;&nbsp;In addition, the Company&#8217;s actual or projected operating results may fail to match its past performance.&nbsp;&nbsp;The Company&#8217;s operating results and financial condition may fluctuate due to a number of factors, including those listed below and those identified throughout this &#8220;Risk Factors&#8221; section:</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -27pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

		</tr>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt;">Due to all of the foregoing factors and the other risks discussed in this &#8220;Risk Factors&#8221; section, you should not rely on quarter-to-quarter or year-to-year comparisons of the Company&#8217;s operating results as an indicator of future performance.</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left;"><b>Risks Related to Our Common Stock</b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 14.7pt 0pt -3pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><i><b>An active trading market for the Company&#8217;s shares of common stock may not develop.</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">The Company&#8217;s common stock has been listed for trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market since 1999 and persistently has experienced limited trading volume.&nbsp;&nbsp;There can be no assurance that an active public market for the Company&#8217;s shares will develop or be sustained.&nbsp;&nbsp;The lack of an active trading market could adversely affect the price and liquidity of the Company&#8217;s common stock.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><i><b>The Company&#8217;s directors and officers own a large percentage of the Company&#8217;s common stock, which may allow them to collectively exert significant influence over substantially all matters requiring shareholder approval.</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">As of December&nbsp;31, 2020, the Company&#8217;s directors and officers collectively beneficially owned approximately 14.2% of its common stock outstanding as of that date.&nbsp;&nbsp;As a result, the Company&#8217;s directors and officers could exert significant influence over all matters requiring a shareholder vote, including the election of directors, amendments to the Company&#8217;s articles of incorporation, and extraordinary transactions such as mergers or going private transactions.&nbsp;&nbsp;These ownership positions may have the effect of delaying, deterring or preventing a change in control or a change in the composition of the Company&#8217;s board of directors.&nbsp;&nbsp;In addition, substantial sales of shares beneficially owned by our directors or officers could be viewed negatively by third parties and have a negative impact on the Company&#8217;s stock price.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><i><b>The price of the Company&#8217;s common stock may fluctuate significantly.</b></i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">The price of the Company&#8217;s common stock has, and could continue to, fluctuate substantially in a short period of time.&nbsp;&nbsp;The price of the Company&#8217;s common stock could vary for many reasons, including the following:</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b><u>Item 2.&nbsp; Property</u></b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">The Company primarily conducts its operations in Duluth, Minnesota.&nbsp; The administrative, sales, research and development, quality and most of the manufacturing activities are housed in a 60,000 square-foot, four-story building, including a basement level.&nbsp; The building is approximately eighty&nbsp;years old and the Company believes it has&nbsp;been maintained in good condition.&nbsp; The Company also utilizes a 5,625 square-foot warehouse adjacent to the existing plant building that was constructed in 1997.&nbsp; These facilities are owned by the Company with no existing liens or leases. &nbsp;The Company also owns an approximately 11-acre property with a 62,300 square-foot manufacturing and warehouse facility.&nbsp;&nbsp;The 62,300 square-foot facility is comprised of a 35,000 square-foot warehousing and manufacturing facility constructed in 2008 and a 27,300 square-foot expansion completed in 2016 to accommodate the Company&#8217;s AMS business. The entire facility on the 11-acre property is collateral on the Company&#8217;s $3.4 million loan.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b><u>Item 3.&nbsp;&nbsp;Legal Proceedings</u></b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b><u>Item 5.&nbsp;&nbsp;Market for Common Equity, Related Stockholder Matters and Issuer Purchases of Equity Securities</u></b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">The Company&#8217;s Common Stock is traded on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol "IKNX."&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">As of Februar<font style="background-color:null;"><font style="background-color:null;">y&nbsp;26, 2021, the Company had</font>&nbsp;54&nbsp;holders of record.&nbsp; The C</font>ompany has not declared cash dividends in the past two years and does not currently have plans to pay any cash dividends in the future. Any future declaration and payment of dividends is within the sole discretion of the Company&#8217;s board of directors.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;</p>
